entries.title: Basketball ML
entries.description: Used IMU sensors and machine learning to classify shot outcome, position, and player experience · achieving 94% location accuracy. Published at IEEE ICNC 2024.

entries.title: IoT Gesture
entries.description: IoT fertilizer spiller with ESP32, dual-mode operation (manual and gesture), and neural network deployment for real-time agricultural automation.

entries.title: FPGA Game
entries.description: VHDL-coded real-time game on FPGA board with random object generation, collision detection, and score display via VGA output.

entries.title: VisiMed CT
entries.description: Medical imaging innovation presented at the 2024 Capital Region Bioinnovation Bootcamp. Finalist · developed a workflow for safer, more accessible CT diagnostics.

entries.title: Safe System
entries.description: Secure safe with alphanumeric keypad, break-beam sensor detection, LED and siren notification, and servo lock using STM32 microcontroller.

entries.title: Arthroscope CAD
entries.description: Surgical arthroscope and camera system designed in SolidWorks for orthopedic applications, focusing on manufacturability and ergonomics.

entries.title: Judo Analysis
entries.description: Mathematical modeling to analyze flip trajectories in Judo, comparing expert and novice performance using centroid tracking and Python/MATLAB.

entries.title: Med Dispenser
entries.description: Arduino-based system for automated medication dispensing with safety lock, LED notification, and ultrasonic sensing.
